desc: Extract indices of White vertices ($W$) and Black vertices ($B$) from the input string $S$ and sort them.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353 for combinatorial calculations.
Implement a function to calculate the number of valid matchings (0 backward edges) for two sorted lists of size $k$.
Iterate over all pairs $(w, b)$ where $w \in W, b \in B$ and $w > b$. For each pair, calculate the number of ways to match the remaining vertices such that no backward edges exist.
Sum these counts modulo 998244353 and print the result.
